body.name: Reported Financial Fact
body.description: One numeric fact from an SEC filing (table num): the value of one XBRL tag (num.tag) for one period (num.ddate, num.qtrs) in one filing (num.adsh). Revenue, net income and total assets are rows of this table, selected by num.tag: revenue = 'Revenues', else 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax', else 'RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense' (banks); net income = 'NetIncomeLoss', else 'NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersBasic'; total assets = 'Assets'. A company total is ONE row: never SUM num.value across tags or filings. Join num to sub on num.adsh = sub.adsh (the filing). Join num to tag on BOTH num.tag = tag.tag AND num.version = tag.version. Never join num to pre or num to tag on tag alone.
